signatures.description: Build an incremental linker for WebAssembly object modules that relocates code and stack-map metadata after function insertion or deletion without rebuilding unaffected modules. It must preserve stable external symbol identities, correctly update LEB128-sized offsets when encodings change length, and reject malformed or cyclic relocation dependencies deterministically.
